initial_prompt: Can you help me fix this sentence: "She don't want to go"

messages.content: Can you help me fix this sentence: "She don't want to go"

"She doesn't want to go."

The fix: *don't* → *doesn't*. Third-person singular subjects (she, he, it) take "doesn't" rather than "don't."
